1.title: What happened in failed execution of Christa Pike - and what next?
1.summary: The convicted killer is in hospital in Tennessee after surviving two lethal injections, in a case that has raised many questions.

2.title: US death row inmate survives execution attempt after two lethal injections
2.summary: Killer Christa Pike's lawyer says she is being given "life-saving measures" in hospital after two syringes of pentobarbital.

3.title: Jordan 'Last Dance' jersey sells for £9m
3.summary: A Michael Jordan jersey from his 'Last Dance' season sells for $12.3m, a record for a piece of Jordan memorabilia.

4.title: Zimbabwe tycoon Wicknell Chivayo and wife killed in helicopter crash
4.summary: Chivayo was known for his lavish lifestyle, close ties to African presidents and lucrative government contracts.

5.title: Live Updates: Israelis Celebrate Passengers’ Return as Questions Swirl Over Flight Attack
5.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu praised the flight’s injured captain, Israeli passengers and reserve pilots, who helped secure the plane and land it safely. The attacker has not been identified.

6.title: Britain and France Give Up Landmark Migrant Agreement
6.summary: The French government soured on a reciprocal deal that allowed the British authorities to return some migrants who crossed the English Channel illegally in small boats.
